name: speaker_partial_final_pass_keeps_voices
description: One batch-lane recording of three real voices taking short turns (public LibriSpeech, 35 s): the owner, an enrolled person and an unenrolled stranger; Finish is tapped while capturing. The resolver groups the voices and marks the conversation resolved; the whole-conversation final pass then cannot place two one-word segments (diarizer-gap words) and applies the rest (failed_unassigned_words). Before BATCH_FINAL_PASS_KEEP_RESOLVED_ON_PARTIAL_ENABLED the applied segments took new speaker ids beside the resolver's and the conversation became unavailable, which the app shows as plain "Speaker" for every unnamed voice (measured 2026-11-26). With it each final-pass voice reuses the resolver voice holding most of its words, one to one, and the conversation stays resolved. voices allows one extra: the two one-word fragments are the resolver's own abstentions (unit scope), left as they were by both passes.

budget.note: Measured 2026-11-26 on the lab host, --stt replay --speakers replay (159 reads, 55 writes, 1 delete(s), 4 no-op, 1 STT cassette play, 5 LLM; caps about +10%). Gallery enrollment runs before the first event and is not counted. noop_writes=4 is the current count, the same two sites as speaker_owner_and_person_finish: 2 database/conversations_v3_leases.py renew (lab-clock repeat), 2 database/dream_store.py:126 mark_dirty.
